fields.eyebrow: FEDERAL & STATE CONTRACTING INFRASTRUCTURE • FREE FOR LABOR & BUSINESSES
fields.title: Institutional Workforce & Subcontractor Intelligence.
fields.subtitle: EVOGovCon bridges the gap between federal appropriations and field execution—algorithmically mapping skilled trade labor to six-digit NAICS codes, certifying small business readiness, and delivering audit-ready diversity pipelines for prime contractors.

fields.heading: Three Portals. One Unified Supply Chain.
fields.intro: Purpose-built workflows for skilled trade operators, certified small businesses, and prime contracting executives.

cards.title: Skilled Trade Workforce
cards.body: Map your trade credentials to federal NAICS codes automatically, complete your vendor readiness track, and get recruited directly for prevailing-wage government contracts.

cards.title: Certified Subcontractors
cards.body: Position your firm in front of prime contractors searching by socioeconomic set-aside and NAICS code, generate capability statements, and post jobs to hire verified field labor.

cards.title: Prime Contractors & GCs
cards.body: Filter pre-vetted subcontractors by certification (DBE, MBE, WBE, HUB, SDVOSB), dispatch targeted RFQs, and document good-faith diversity compliance in seconds.

fields.heading: Four Stages from Registration to Contract Award
fields.intro: A structured, compliance-first onboarding pipeline engineered to eliminate federal procurement friction.

steps.label: Establish Verified Credentials
steps.detail: Register your primary trade, equipment capabilities, service radius, and active licenses in under five minutes.

steps.label: Automated NAICS Classification
steps.detail: Our engine translates your field capabilities into exact 6-digit federal NAICS codes used by contracting officers and prime estimators.

steps.label: Execute Readiness Protocol
steps.detail: Follow guided tracks for SAM.gov UEI issuance, capability statement generation, and HUB / DBE / 8(a) / SDVOSB certification.

steps.label: Receive Direct Solicitations
steps.detail: Respond to targeted RFQs from prime contractors and apply directly to subcontracting and labor opportunities in your corridor.

fields.heading: $65 Billion Broadband & Civil Infrastructure Deployment
fields.text: Federal appropriations require immediate mobilization of fiber optic technicians, cell tower crews, civil earthwork operators, and CDL logistics fleets. Position your profile in the active procurement directory today.

fields.heading: 13 Core Infrastructure Classifications
fields.body: Every trade maps directly to active federal and state NAICS procurement codes. Select your discipline to initialize registration or explore all 22 infrastructure trade categories and 58 federal NAICS codes on the Labor Portal.

fields.heading: Engineered for Public Sector Compliance.
fields.intro: Every tool required to transition from independent contractor to verified government vendor—consolidated into a single architecture.

cards.title: Algorithmic NAICS Code Matching
cards.body: Select your trade specialization and equipment inventory—EVOGovCon automatically maps your profile to the exact 6-digit North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) codes used by federal and state procurement officers.

cards.title: Prime-to-Sub Dispatch
cards.body: Verified prime contractors filter our directory by NAICS and certification to issue direct connection requests and RFQs without middlemen.

cards.title: Vendor Readiness Tracks
cards.body: Interactive checklists guide you through SAM.gov UEI registration, business banking, insurance compliance, and capability statements.

cards.title: Socioeconomic & Diversity Certification Matrix
cards.body: Full support and tracking for DBE, MBE, WBE, Texas HUB, SDVOSB, WOSB, HUBZone, and SBA 8(a) designations—enabling prime contractors to fulfill mandated federal participation goals with verified documentation.

cards.title: Corridor & Radius Matching
cards.body: Opportunities are filtered by your home ZIP code and mobilization range—whether local municipal work, statewide DOT corridors, or national deployment.

cards.title: Permissioned Directory & Role Governance
cards.body: Your credentials and capability documentation remain protected behind role-based access controls. Contact details are only exchanged when you approve a prime or business connection.

fields.heading: Audit-Ready Compliance in 7 Milestones
fields.alertLabel: Our interactive readiness engine structures federal and state onboarding into verifiable milestones so you never miss a mandatory filing:
items: Obtain your free SAM.gov Unique Entity ID (UEI)
Activate federal vendor registration on SAM.gov
Establish a dedicated commercial banking & EIN structure
Generate a print-ready One-Page Capability Statement
File qualifying set-asides (HUB, DBE, WOSB, SDVOSB, 8(a))
Respond to matched prime contractor RFQs & Job Solicitations
